name: Rest/Sleep Mixed Berry RSO Gummies 10-pack
description: RSO Gummies are made using the highest quality, full spectrum cannabis oil that is encapsulated using nano-technology. Not only does the encapsulation process make these gummies fast acting, it also improves the oil's taste. The Rest formula is Indica enhanced with a mixed berry flavor and contains a blend of THC, CBD and CBN that promotes rest and relaxation. Activation time is 5-15 minutes.
